<thought>To determine the number of carbonyl (C=O) groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample. Carbonyl carbons appear in the downfield region (≈190–220 ppm for ketones, 160–185 ppm for esters/amides, etc.). By counting distinct peaks in that region, I can infer the number of carbonyl carbons, which equals the number of carbonyl groups. I will request the carbon NMR spectrum.</thought>
